articles.title: Iraq has reached understandings with US to allow oil exports through Hormuz, minister says
articles.description: Nov 8 (Reuters) - Iraq has reached understandings with the United States to allow Iraqi oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz via a shipping lane near Oman, Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said in an interview with Al Jazeera.He said Iraq's losses from the Iran war and disruptions to oil exports had reached $60 billion.Iraq's oil exports recovered in October after a sharp drop the previous month. Exports rose to about 3.5 million barrels per day from 2.65 million bpd in September, according to Iraqi energy officials.

articles.title: US asks Iraq to shut most Iran border crossings, Iraqi foreign minister says
articles.description: Nov 8 (Reuters) - The US Treasury has asked Iraq to close all border crossings with Iran except for two as part of Washington's policy of increasing economic pressure on Tehran, Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said in an interview with Al Jazeera.One of the exceptions is in the Kurdistan region. "There are many official and unofficial border crossings with Iran, and closing all of them would be difficult and would affect our economy. The Americans are still demanding the closure of the crossings, and we are currently in discussions with them," Hussein said.

articles.title: Iran distributes iodine tablets amid fears of possible US strikes on nuclear sites: Report
articles.description: Iran has started to distribute iodine tablets to populations near its nuclear facilities amid escalating tensions. The decision comes as concerns grow over potential military action from the United States. Recent reports indicate that US officials are considering strikes on Iran's nuclear sites. This heightened alertness follows significant discussions within the US administration regarding military options. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi has also asserted Iraq's sovereignty during these deliberations.
